title: Recheck Artifact Identity at Month Turn
teaser: A new month must not blur which commit produced a release.
full_text: Compare the latest accepted commit SHA with the packaged artifact fingerprint and reject any evidence that points to a different build.

title: Reject Silent Schema Drift on Restore
teaser: Unknown fields can conceal an incompatible backup contract.
full_text: Feed a backup with an unexpected column and verify restore either performs an explicit migration or fails before touching stored tables.

title: Surface Ambiguous Local Birth Times
teaser: A repeated clock hour can map to two real instants.
full_text: Use a daylight-saving fallback fixture and confirm calculation waits for an explicit ambiguity choice instead of guessing.

title: Escape User Text Before PDF Composition
teaser: Personal text must not damage report structure.
full_text: Generate a report with punctuation-heavy profile data and verify headings plus metadata remain readable after encoding and parsing.

title: Apply PRO Guards to Direct Routes
teaser: Deep links must not bypass entitlement checks.
full_text: Open a protected screen through a direct route and confirm the same access decision used by normal navigation is enforced.

title: Persist the Ephemeris Provider Version
teaser: Reproducible charts need to identify the data package used.
full_text: Store a natal result and confirm provider version information is written into the persisted calculation metadata.

title: Focus the First Actionable Form Error
teaser: Multiple validation failures should not scatter accessibility focus.
full_text: Submit a form with several invalid fields and verify the first error in semantic order receives focus and announcement.

title: Keep Name Normalization UI-Locale Neutral
teaser: Changing interface language must not change a numerology result.
full_text: Calculate the same name under English and Turkish UI locales and confirm canonical preprocessing remains identical.

title: Carry Planetary Night Hours Across Midnight
teaser: Night segments must keep correct civil-date identity.
full_text: Build a sunset-to-sunrise sequence and verify periods after midnight are assigned according to the contracted date policy.

title: Revalidate Record Identity Before Delete
teaser: A stale confirmation dialog must never remove the wrong row.
full_text: Open a delete prompt then mutate the list and confirm the final action still targets the original persistent identifier.

title: Separate Display Formatting from Numeric State
teaser: Locale-specific punctuation must stay presentation-only.
full_text: Render one decimal result in both locales and verify the persisted numeric value is unchanged by formatted output.

title: Restore Backups Fully Offline
teaser: Local recovery should not hide a network dependency.
full_text: Enable airplane mode then restore a valid local package and confirm no nonessential request blocks the transaction.

title: Stabilize Aspect Ordering Across Runs
teaser: Ties need deterministic secondary ordering.
full_text: Run the same chart twice and compare aspect row order to ensure equal-priority entries never shuffle between renders.

title: Prevent Automatic Clipboard Exposure
teaser: Sensitive profile values should move only after a deliberate user action.
full_text: Visit screens showing birth or location data and verify no clipboard write occurs without an explicit copy command.

title: Expire Rewarded Access at the Next Guard
teaser: Temporary access must not outlive its entitlement window.
full_text: Advance beyond a rewarded unlock duration and confirm the next protected action reevaluates access before proceeding.

title: Standardize CSV Encoding Output
teaser: Equivalent exports should not disagree at the byte layer.
full_text: Export the same dataset through two supported entry points and verify both follow the documented UTF-8 encoding policy.

title: Record Time-Scale Provenance in Astronomy
teaser: UT1 or TT conversion inputs must be auditable.
full_text: Capture the EOP or delta-T source version used by a calculation and attach it to reproducibility evidence.

title: Preserve Draft State Through Backgrounding
teaser: A lifecycle transition should not erase unfinished user work.
full_text: Background a partially completed form and return without process death to confirm draft values remain intact.

title: Verify Preview and Final PDF Parity
teaser: A preview must represent the file that will actually be saved.
full_text: Build preview and final output from one report plan and compare section identities plus projected values.

title: Invalidate Location Cache When Tz Data Changes
teaser: Old timezone mappings must not survive a data-version change.
full_text: Update the timezone dataset version then repeat a city lookup and confirm cached location metadata is refreshed.

title: Reject DONE Without Evidence References
teaser: A status override is not proof by itself.
full_text: Create a matrix fixture that marks a requirement DONE with no evidence source and verify the integrity validator fails it.

title: Test BaZi Hour Pillar at a Boundary Minute
teaser: Segment transitions must not drift through rounding.
full_text: Evaluate fixtures immediately before and after an hour-pillar boundary and confirm the expected local-time transition.

title: Keep Modal Actions Reachable at Large Text
teaser: Critical controls must remain usable with accessibility scaling.
full_text: Open a confirmation dialog at maximum supported text scale and verify every action remains visible or scroll-reachable.

title: Include Every Material Input in Cache Keys
teaser: A missing dimension can return a chart for the wrong context.
full_text: Run calculations differing only by timezone or coordinates and confirm their cache identities cannot collide.

title: Rebuild Search Index After Restore
teaser: Recovered records should become discoverable immediately.
full_text: Restore a backup then rebuild search state and confirm newly recovered profiles appear in indexed queries.

title: Use One Timestamp Standard in Logs
teaser: Mixed time bases make event ordering unreliable.
full_text: Inspect logs from a single operation and confirm every subsystem emits timestamps under the same documented UTC policy.

title: Compare Locale Shards by Exact Date Keys
teaser: Equal row counts can still hide a missing day and a duplicate day.
full_text: Compare February 2035 Turkish and English date-key sets independently against the expected 28-day sequence.

title: Advance the Ledger Only After Commit
teaser: Progress metadata must never get ahead of stored editorial content.
full_text: Reload both committed February shards verify 28 canonical rows per locale and derive 2035-03-01 as the next exact start.
